Shipping

All orders are processed and shipped within 1-3 working days on average. We offer worldwide delivery, with arrival times typically within 4-6 working days. Every order includes tracking information once shipped.

Returns

Not satisfied with your purchase? No problem—we’re here to help! You may return your item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange, no questions asked. To initiate a return, please contact our customer service team at support@thefleeceblanket.com.
